additional_sources.title: Technical guidance for regulated industry sectors: environmental permitting
additional_sources.guard: Sector guidance establishes regulatory and BAT context across combustion, chemicals, refining, metals, waste and other activities; it cannot become a measured parcel GHG value without compatible observed quantity and verified geometry.

additional_sources.title: Industrial Emissions Directive (IED): environmental permits issued 2026 – S to Z
additional_sources.guard: The collection lists current 2026 permit decisions and dates and can support installation/permit identity; collection membership alone does not quantify greenhouse-gas emissions.

additional_sources.title: DE7 4BG, Castle Waste Services Limited: environmental permit issued - EPR/AP3337SJ/V009
additional_sources.guard: A named operator, installation and permit number provide strong facility-binding evidence; permit issuance must not be interpreted as an observed annual GHG value.

additional_sources.title: DN40 3DX, S.A.R. Metals Limited: environmental permit application advertisement - EPR/TP3821SN/A003
additional_sources.guard: The application gives a named regulated facility, permit application number and monitoring/modelling scope; application information is not a verified emissions measurement.

additional_sources.title: Application for an environmental permit: low risk medium combustion plant and specified generator
additional_sources.guard: Application requirements and decarbonisation-readiness fields are administrative/regulatory evidence and do not establish actual emissions performance.

additional_sources.title: Application for an environmental permit: part B2.5 bespoke medium combustion plant and specified generator permit
additional_sources.guard: Bespoke MCP/generator application forms can support equipment and permit scope but not observed GHG quantities.

additional_sources.title: Apply for an environmental permit
additional_sources.guard: Permit application workflow is administrative provenance only; physical emissions and parcel identity require separate validated sources.

additional_sources.title: Environmental permits: when and how you are charged
additional_sources.guard: Permit charge schedules help currentity and permit-process validation but contain no physical emissions measurement.

guard_contract.MEASUREMENT_CANDIDATE: Reported or monitored source data requires row-level pollutant/gas, unit, method, year, facility identity and verified parcel geometry before promotion.
guard_contract.BINDING_CANDIDATE: Permit or facility data supports identity/binding only; no emissions quantity is implied.
guard_contract.SPATIAL_CANDIDATE: Map/grid/boundary data supports spatial matching only; no measured emissions quantity is implied.
guard_contract.SOURCE_UPGRADE: Guidance, factors, methods, limits or aggregate/administrative records cannot become parcel GHG without compatible observed quantity and verified geometry.
